title: TaskStatusVocabulary
description: Engines describe outcomes; the platform has its own statuses. Returning an engine word verbatim left the SSE stream open and made finish_task record a success as a failure.
$comment: Mapping lives in dataagent-backend/core/task_status.py: success->finished, cancelled->suspended, failed/error->error; finished->completed, error->failed, suspended->suspended.
